recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed unless a future Pharmacy decision intentionally changes MedicationStatement.reason or MedicationStatement.adherence.reason semantics.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive Pharmacy issue requesting removal of MedicationStatement mst-2 and mst-3 because reasonForUse represents the intended reason for use and should remain valid even when the medication was not actually taken.

additional_context: MedicationStatement remains active in source/fhir.ini. Later source history renamed reasonForUseCodeableConcept/reasonForUseReference to reasonCode/reasonReference, and current migration metadata maps reasonCode/reasonReference into the merged MedicationStatement.reason element. FHIR-11091 is a nearby naming-consistency issue but does not conflict with the FHIR-12255 correction.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current MedicationStatement.reason has no notTaken/wasNotTaken gating constraint, MedicationStatement.adherence.reason separately covers non-use/adherence reasons, and current source searches found no stale mst-2/mst-3 or reasonForUse restriction text.
